description: Environment contract between the warp-server dispatch path and the Warp client for Agent Plugins in a file-managed Factory run. warp-server asserts the producing half against this file; the Warp client vendors a verbatim copy and asserts the consuming half, so a divergence appears as a diff between two committed files.

environment_variables.name: WARP_SKILL_DIRS
environment_variables.order: most specific first: agent, then factory

environment_variables.name: WARP_PLUGIN_DIRS
environment_variables.order: most specific first: automation, then bound agent, then factory
environment_variables.notes: Each entry is a plugin collection directory. The client enumerates immediate child directories as packages; a package whose manifest name repeats in a later directory is shadowed by the earlier one.

environment_variables.name: WARP_FACTORY_MCP_FILES
environment_variables.order: most specific first: automation, then bound agent, then factory
environment_variables.notes: The client loads ordinary entries and ignores managed entries, which Factory sync already projected.

environment_variables.name: WARP_FACTORY_UID
environment_variables.notes: Identity and diagnostics only. It is never used to compose a path: the plugin data root already carries it.

environment_variables.name: WARP_PLUGIN_DATA_ROOT
environment_variables.notes: Absence means the backend has no durable storage, and the client must not start a Factory plugin stdio MCP server.

notes: The Factory UID is baked into the exported root by the server so two Factories running as the same principal cannot share a data directory.
The client keeps its own local layout (plugins/data/<hash>) for non-Factory plugins; this contract governs Factory plugins only.
